package.name: Finco1 Controlled Generic Scenario Pilot Runbook

pilot_ux_objective.ux_clarity: are the Generic Modelling UI changes clear and understandable?
pilot_ux_objective.task_efficiency: can users complete their Generic Modelling tasks faster or with fewer errors?
pilot_ux_objective.visual_consistency: are the visual changes consistent across the app?
pilot_ux_objective.no_regression: do the UI changes break any existing user task?
pilot_ux_objective.exploratory_banner_visibility: is the exploratory banner visible for Generic Solar / Generic Wind?
pilot_ux_objective.what_changed_panel_validation: does the What Changed panel render correctly for Generic Solar / Wind scenarios with at least 2 runs?
what_validation_is_not: production readiness or enterprise SaaS readiness claim
Excel-parity validation for Generic Solar / Wind

user_task_list.task_name: Open the index page. Verify that the runtime summary, validation summary, and banner context are visible.
Create a Generic Solar project. Verify that the project creation flow is functional and the exploratory banner is visible.
Generic Solar task: edit a Generic Solar scenario, save it, run it, and verify that the output is generated.
Generic Wind task: edit a Generic Wind scenario, save it, run it, and verify that the output is generated.
Scenario duplicate / edit / save / run task: duplicate a scenario, edit it, save it, run it, and verify that the output is generated.
Compare task: open the scenario compare and verify that the 2-way compare is functional.
3-way / 4-way compare task: open the 3-way / 4-way compare and verify that it is functional.
Multi-compare task: open the multi-compare picker and verify that the picker is functional.
Export / download task: export a Generic scenario as a downloadable artifact and verify that the artifact is generated correctly.
What Changed panel task: edit a Generic Solar scenario, re-run it, and verify that the What Changed panel renders the deltas correctly.
Exploratory banner task: verify that the exploratory banner is visible for Generic Solar / Generic Wind scenarios.
Factory project safety task: open a factory project (TUHO / Oborovo), verify that the What Changed panel is NOT rendered, and verify that the run summary output is unchanged.

what_is_not_allowed: Any project that is not in the canonical reference set.
Any production customer data. No production customer data is available; the controlled pilot uses only the canonical reference projects and the Generic Solar / Generic Wind projects.

prohibited_data: Production customer data (not available; canonical reference projects and Generic Solar / Wind only).
Any data that is not in the canonical reference set or the Generic Solar / Wind projects.
Any data that is restricted by the project's security / privacy policy.

setup_checklist.description: The controlled pilot uses a local or staging environment with the canonical reference projects and the Generic Solar / Generic Wind projects loaded.
A designated internal user is assigned to the controlled pilot. The pilot user is internal, not external.

setup_checklist.item: The pilot user acknowledgement is signed.
setup_checklist.description: The B21 pilot user acknowledgement checklist is completed by the pilot user. The acknowledgement is internal governance, not a legal contract.

setup_checklist.item: The pilot evidence register is initialized.
setup_checklist.description: The B20 pilot evidence register template is initialized with the pilot start date, the pilot end date, the pilot user, the canonical reference projects, and the Generic Solar / Generic Wind projects.

setup_checklist.item: The pilot issue log is initialized.
setup_checklist.description: The B20 pilot issue log template is initialized.

setup_checklist.item: The pilot friction log is initialized.
setup_checklist.description: The B45 friction log (in this runbook) is initialized.

setup_checklist.item: The pilot confusion log is initialized.
setup_checklist.description: The B45 confusion log (in this runbook) is initialized.

run_checklist.item: The pilot user opens the index page.
run_checklist.description: The pilot user records the screenshot, the console log, the network log, and the tab navigation trace.

run_checklist.item: The pilot user runs through tasks T1-T12.
run_checklist.description: The pilot user records the screenshot, the console log, the network log, and the tab navigation trace for each task.

run_checklist.item: The pilot user records friction points.
run_checklist.description: The pilot user records any friction point in the B45 friction log.

run_checklist.item: The pilot user records confusion points.
run_checklist.description: The pilot user records any confusion point in the B45 confusion log.
The pilot user records any issue in the B20 pilot issue log.
The pilot user records any evidence in the B20 pilot evidence register.

evidence_to_collect: Screenshots of the UI for each task.
Browser console logs for each task.
Browser network logs for each task.
Tab navigation traces for each task.

issue_severity_definitions.low: cosmetic or minor UX issue. Does not block the controlled pilot.
issue_severity_definitions.medium: functional issue that the pilot user can work around. Does not block the controlled pilot but should be fixed in a follow-up PR.
issue_severity_definitions.high: functional issue that blocks one or more tasks. Blocks the controlled pilot until fixed.

stop_criteria: High-severity issue is identified that blocks one or more tasks.
Critical data integrity issue is identified.
The pilot user is unable to complete any task due to a UI or persistence issue.
The pilot user requests a stop.
rollback_escalation_criteria: A financial output drift is detected on TUHO or Oborovo.
A parity-core lock drift is detected.
An engine-output golden drift is detected on TUHO or Oborovo.
A model output drift is detected on TUHO or Oborovo.
A schema / migration drift is detected.
A persistence / repository drift is detected.
The factory project run summary output is NOT byte-identical to the pre-Phase-25B-3 path.
The exploratory banner is missing for Generic Solar / Generic Wind scenarios.
post_run_evidence_update: B21 pilot user acknowledgement (per-item sign-off entries)
what_blocks_controlled_pilot: High-severity UX issue that blocks one or more tasks.
Financial output drift on TUHO or Oborovo.
Engine-output golden drift on TUHO or Oborovo.
Model output drift on TUHO or Oborovo.
Factory project run summary output is NOT byte-identical to the pre-Phase-25B-3 path.
Exploratory banner is missing for Generic Solar / Generic Wind scenarios.
Any hard-stop condition from the B25 / B33 / B35 stop / go checklists.
what_can_be_fixed_later: Medium-severity UX issues that the pilot user can work around.
global_notes: The controlled pilot is internal, not external. It is not a customer reference. It does not authorize paid pilot.
The controlled pilot is not the external review. The external review is a separate workstream.

B18, B20, B21, B22, B23, B39 are the B-track governance artifacts that govern the controlled pilot. B45 is a Generic-Scenario-focused runbook that supplements the B18 / B20 / B21 / B22 / B23 / B39 artifacts.
Claude review / post-51T review are separate workstreams. They are referenced only as review evidence, not external validation or certification.
